# HAPI v0.29.0.2 (maintained build)

Upstream-first rebuild from `tiann/hapi` `upstream/main` at `980a921ba15665c54998a6ddb658103d467ff4cb`, with the audited self-maintained overlay and selected open-PR fixes.

## Compared with the previous maintained release

Compared with `v0.29.0.1`, this release:

- Includes all 26 post-`v0.29.0` upstream commits through `#1696`, including Cursor ACP steer, unified message actions, DeepSeek Harness, attachment reordering, agent availability and workspace validation, exports, native fixes, and Bun 1.4.0.
- Fixes the self-build-only duplicate queued-message Steer action. Pi, Codex, and Cursor ACP retain one guarded Steer button per immediate determinate row.
- Carries or refreshes 34 audited current PR heads: `#1418`, `#1424`, `#1436`, `#1468`, `#1542`, `#1543`, `#1581`, `#1604`, `#1607`, `#1615`, `#1616`, `#1620`, `#1621`, `#1633`, `#1635`, `#1636`, `#1637`, `#1644`, `#1656`, `#1660`, `#1662`, `#1664`, `#1666`, `#1671`, `#1678`, `#1679`, `#1683`, `#1685`, `#1694`, `#1702`, `#1707`, `#1715`, `#1720`, and `#1721`.
- Retains previously shipped audited behavior for `#1158`, `#1414`, `#1421`, `#1422`, `#1451`, and `#1592`. `#1419` is coalesced into `#1436`; `#1610` and `#1647` are accepted through their upstream equivalents without duplicate replay.
- Adds atomic archived project deletion, V29 ACP usage/cost migration, model-bound Copilot/Kimi effort discovery with readiness polling, Webhook and WxPusher notification channels, title-provider diagnostics, Claude Rewind, Codex round metadata, and Pi image-result rendering.
- Retains fork PR `swear01/hapi#11` machine uptime; its Gemini warning was invalid because `useMachines()` always returns an array.
- Removes the operator-dropped managed-provider subsystem (`#1091`), response-navigation stack (`#1093`/`#1597`), stale `pinActiveSessions` option, accidental `.claude/worktrees` gitlink, and 9.7 MB of unreproducible historical patch queues.
- Repairs release tooling: paginated open-PR audits, origin-specific tag refs, pinned upstream SHA, exact-main release tags, safe `~/.agent-worktrees` rehearsal, rehearsal-only sync, Bun 1.4 frozen installs, embedded-version validation, and fork Pages skip.

## Compared with the official release

Compared with official `v0.29.0`, this build also contains post-release upstream work from `upstream/main`, the 34 PR integrations above, the retained self-maintained desktop/fleet/import/jobs/model-error/scratchlist features, schema version 29, and protocol version 2.

Open-PR audit: 131 open PRs reviewed — 42 carry, 85 defer, 4 drop. `#1680` is dropped on exact-head findings. `#1718`, `#1719`, and `#1722` are deferred after exact-head review; focused `#1720` and `#1721` fixes are carried. `#1320` remains permanently excluded if reopened. Current `#987` and `#1360` heads are deferred; model-error detection/banner/notifications and prior notification preferences remain, while unfinished manual/automatic Bridge controls are removed.

## Distribution

This is a standalone four-part maintained release; it is not published to npm. Its implicit standalone fleet-upgrade channel is therefore disabled, while explicit overrides remain authoritative. Optional platform packages remain pinned to official `0.29.0`.

Expected artifacts:

- CLI archives for Linux, macOS, and Windows
- Signed macOS CLI archives
- Windows and macOS desktop bundles
- `checksums.txt`
